say:6:1320208004:1.text: WE'RE. LOOKING FOR. HUNTER KLIFF'S WIFE!!!
say:6:1320208004:1.source_cn: 我们！在找！克利夫的妻子！！！

say:7:1320208005:1.text: Oh, Kliff! This furball here's got quite a voice on him!
say:7:1320208005:1.source_cn: 哦，克利夫，你这小胖球嗓门可不小。

say:8:1320208006:1.text: Right, so Kliff... Who's Kliff again? ... You guys are looking for Snowflake Pirdy's husband, right?
say:8:1320208006:1.source_cn: 对啊……克利夫，克利夫是谁来着……你们莫不是在找雪花珀...

say:9:1320208007:1.text: I suppose so? We know that Kliff is a hunter.
say:9:1320208007:1.source_cn: 应该是吧？我们认识的克利夫是一名猎人。

say:10:1320208008:1.source_cn: 呵、呵，那应该就是了，克利夫的确是名猎人。

say:11:1320208009:1.text: Hey, why can the old man hear you just fine?
say:11:1320208009:1.source_cn: 欸？为什么你讲话爷爷能听到？

say:12:1320208010:1.text: I don't know either. I guess my voice is a bit sharper?
say:12:1320208010:1.source_cn: 我也不懂，可能我的声音更尖锐一些？

say:13:1320208011:1.text: That man married Pirdy, who was from our village. Speaking of Pirdy... All the young men in town had a likin' for her.
say:13:1320208011:1.source_cn: 这个男人娶了我们村的珀蒂，说到珀蒂……当时村里所有的男...

say:14:1320208012:1.text: She was gorgeous like a snowflake—pure and unique. She was so kind and gentle, too, so everyone called her Snowflake.
say:14:1320208012:1.source_cn: 她美的就像是雪花一样冰清玉洁，为人也温柔善良，不知道从...

say:15:1320208013:1.text: Who knew she'd marry a rugged hunter from another village? He even had a funny accent! But he sure managed to capture his wife's heart somehow.
say:15:1320208013:1.source_cn: 唉，谁知道她嫁给了那个外乡来的猎人，操着一口土掉渣的口...

say:16:1320208014:1.text: Okay... Well, we're here to see Pirdy. Could you point us in her direction, please?
say:16:1320208014:1.source_cn: 呃……我们是来找珀蒂的，能麻烦您指下她家的方向吗？

say:17:1320208015:1.text: Her direction? You mean... You folks want to put flowers on her grave?
say:17:1320208015:1.source_cn: 她家？哦……你是说要给她的墓地献花吗？

say:19:1320208017:1.text: Well, yes. Ol' Pirdy died ages ago, back when I was still a young man.
say:19:1320208017:1.source_cn: 是的，早在几十年前珀蒂就去世了，那时候我还很年轻。

say:21:1320208019:1.text:
Yes, of course! Where was I...
Oh, right. Pirdy left us.
say:21:1320208019:1.source_cn: 是的啊，我说到哪了？\n噢对……珀蒂离开了我们。

say:22:1320208020:1.text: The story goes that Kliff went out hunting and didn't come back. We looked for him everywhere—except the Duskmire Forest, of course—and he didn't turn up anywhere.
say:22:1320208020:1.source_cn: 据说是因为克利夫外出狩猎没有回来，除了黑森林我们都找遍...

say:23:1320208021:1.text: Some say he must have gotten lost in the Duskmire Forest. Others say he just skipped town on his wife... But who knows what really happened?
say:23:1320208021:1.source_cn: 有人说他可能迷失在黑森林了，也有人说他丢下妻子跑了……...

say:24:1320208022:1.text: All I know is that ol' Pirdy missed her husband so much that she died of heartache on the day of the winter ceremony... The villagers here, we buried her with our own hands, right outside town.
say:24:1320208022:1.source_cn: 珀蒂因为太思念丈夫，在冬日祭奠当天郁郁而终了……村里人...

say:25:1320208023:1.text: It was hard on Pirdy. She just couldn't wait for her husband to find his way back. It was heartbreaking for all of us.
say:25:1320208023:1.source_cn: 真是苦了珀蒂，她最后也没能等到丈夫归来，我们所有人都很心痛。

say:26:1320208024:1.text: Thanks, sir... Magister, we should go see her grave.
say:26:1320208024:1.source_cn: 谢谢爷爷……主人，我们去墓地看看吧。
say:26:1320208024:1.male: Thanks, sir... Magister, we should go see her grave.
say:26:1320208024:1.female: Thanks, sir... Magister, we should go see her grave.

say:28:1320208026:1.text: I said THANKS, SIR!!! WE'RE GOING TO SEE HER GRAVE!!!
say:28:1320208026:1.source_cn: 我说谢谢爷爷！！！我们要去墓地看看！！！

say:29:1320208027:1.text: Oh, good kids, good kids you are... That's nice that you'll pay Pirdy a visit. We all miss her when winter ceremony time comes around.
say:29:1320208027:1.source_cn: 哦，好孩子……好孩子，探望下珀蒂也是好的，每年快到冬日...

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: （大声告知在找克利夫的妻子）
